name: supported-platforms
body:
Supported targets:
- Required: darwin/arm64 (Apple silicon macOS) and windows/amd64.
- Conditional: windows/arm64 is supported only while a GitHub-hosted native Windows ARM runner (`windows-11-arm`) is available to the private repo. If it is not available, windows/arm64 is simply unsupported: it is not built, released or packaged, and there is no manual or self-hosted fallback.

Explicit non-goals: Intel macOS (darwin/amd64) is definitely not supported, and neither is Linux or any other OS/arch.

AC: each release contains exactly one binary per supported target: darwin/arm64 and windows/amd64, plus windows/arm64 only when its native runner was available, and never a darwin/amd64 or Linux binary.
